title: Instruction diet: AGENTS.md as an index, docs/README.md, merge priming docs, archive one-off logs
description:
AGENTS.md is 962 lines and README.md is 994; they overlap heavily and README holds operational runbooks (Local Dev 431 Troubleshooting, Production Content Operations, Newsroom Cloud Procedures Runbook) that belong in docs/. docs/ has 53 files: five cover priming and Cyclotron from different angles (priming-acceptance, priming-proof, reference-priming, relevance-cyclotron, publication-cyclotron-controls); console-chat fix notes now exist in both docs/ and docs/archive on main; several are one-off verification logs. skills/ has machine-specific paths (fixed in the home-path issue).

Fix: rewrite AGENTS.md to about 150 lines of hard rules, each stated once with a link to the test or lint that enforces it (or 'unenforced' where none exists), plus an index into docs/; move runbooks out of README to docs/ and cut README to about 200 lines; add docs/README.md with one line per page; merge the five priming pages into one with a status section; archive verification logs under docs/archive/; delete the docs/ copies of the console-chat notes that main already archived.

Done when: a new agent session can read AGENTS.md in one screen and find every rule's enforcement or its 'unenforced' marker.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
